# Articles

Welcome to the writing section of my portfolio, where I share applied work in experimentation, analytics, and decision-making.

## Featured Post

### [A/B Testing a Call to Action](ab_testing_cta.qmd)

An applied walkthrough of A/B testing for CTA design, covering simulation, the Law of Large Numbers, bootstrap and analytical standard errors, hypothesis testing, regression equivalence, and why peeking can inflate false positives.

### [Does Raising Minimum Wage Kill Jobs?](Hw2_submission.qmd)

A replication-style blog post on Card and Krueger (1994), showing the core Difference-in-Differences result, checking the published employment values against the paper, and explaining where tiny mismatches come from.
